# Pixel Crochet

> Pixel Crochet is a free, open-source app that turns your images — and even Stitch Fiddle text patterns — into a stitch-by-stitch tapestry crochet guide. Every row is read in the direction it is crocheted, every color block is counted for you, and your progress is saved automatically.

Live at https://pixel-crochet.vercel.app/

## What Pixel Crochet is

Pixel Crochet is a bilingual (English/Spanish) app that converts pixel art, cross-stitch, photos or text patterns into an interactive, row-by-row crochet guide. Instead of counting stitches by hand while reading a chart — and unravelling when you lose your place — you follow the current row, tap each color block as you finish it, and the app remembers exactly where you stopped.

- All image processing happens in isolates (`compute`) on your own device. Photos and patterns are never uploaded anywhere.
- The free tier and app are open source under the MIT license. There is no account, no signup and no watermark.
- Runs on the web (Flutter Web), Android and iOS.

## What you can do with it

- Import a PNG or JPG (pixel art, cross-stitch, a logo, a photo of your pet) and choose the stitch grid width.
- Import text patterns in Stitch Fiddle's format by pasting them.
- Remap every detected color to one of the yarn colors you actually own before you start.
- Follow the pattern row by row: each row shows its reading direction, the color blocks with their stitch counts, and the current row highlighted.
- Tap the blocks to mark them done; progress is stored automatically so you can resume later.
- Create a project, share a Ko-fi shop for ready-made patterns (Salchipleto is the brand's dachshund), and request features by email.

## Guides

- [Cómo hacer pixel crochet y tapestry (ES)](https://pixel-crochet.vercel.app/como-hacer-pixel-crochet): what pixel and tapestry crochet are, how they differ from graphgan and C2C, and how to start a piece with the app.
- [Convertir una imagen en patrón de crochet (ES)](https://pixel-crochet.vercel.app/convertir-imagen-a-patron-de-crochet): step-by-step from a photo to a stitch chart.
- [Stitch Fiddle patterns to an interactive guide (EN)](https://pixel-crochet.vercel.app/stitch-fiddle-to-crochet-guide): turn a pasted text pattern into a followable guide.

## Technical facts

- Flutter + Dart, feature-first architecture with Riverpod state management and go_router navigation.
- Color quantization and grid extraction run in isolates via `compute`, keeping the UI responsive for images up to ~5,000,000 pixels and projects up to 100,000 stitches.
- Rows are stored as color blocks (not stitch by stitch) and drawn with a custom `CustomPainter`, highlighting the active row.
- Local persistence via shared storage, plus full l10n (English and Spanish) with flutter_localizations.
